description: CMF project configuration. Controls locale fallback chains, text expansion estimates, and source language settings.

source.description: The language in which all source content is authored. All other languages are translations.

locales.description: BCP-47 language tags of all supported locales for this project.

fallbackChains.description: When a string is missing for a locale, the runtime walks this chain left to right and returns the first available version. The source language ('en') should appear last as the final fallback.

textExpansion.description: Estimated character expansion multipliers relative to English source text. Used by the validator to warn when a single-integer maxLength may be too tight for a given locale's translated string. These are estimates based on average expansion for general prose; UI labels with technical terms may expand differently. Adjust per project after observing actual translation lengths.
textExpansion.reference: Esselink, B. (2000). A Practical Guide to Localization. John Benjamins.
textExpansion.description2: The validator issues a warning when: estimatedLength = floor(sourceLength × multiplier) >= maxLength × warningThreshold. Set warningThreshold closer to 1.0 for stricter warnings; lower it to suppress warnings on strings with comfortable headroom.

workflow.description: Permitted status transitions. The validator warns (not errors) if a file is in a status that doesn't match its content completeness. Transitions are enforced loosely — teams may skip stages as needed.

rules.translation-ready: meta.frozen must be true before promoting to translation-ready.
rules.translator-query: At least one localeReadiness entry must have a translatorQuery.query field.

glossary.description: Glossary files are expected at glossary/{locale}.json. The validator loads available glossaries and checks keyTerms consistency for translated content.
glossary.description2: When enforced is true, the validator raises an error (not a warning) on a keyTerm mismatch with the glossary. Set to false to downgrade to warnings during initial glossary adoption.
